title: TestLoginSession
description: Handle for an in-flight Test Login round-trip. The caller either opens 'authorizationUrl' in a popup (OIDC/SAML) or submits credentials (LDAP/Basic), then polls the result endpoint with 'testSessionId'.

testSessionId.description: Opaque identifier for this test login. Bound to the admin who started it.

authorizationUrl.description: Identity-provider URL the admin must be sent to in an isolated popup. Present for OIDC and SAML only.

requiresCredentials.description: True when the protocol is credential-based (LDAP/Basic) and the caller must submit a username and password instead of opening a popup.

expiresAt.description: Time after which this test session is no longer valid.
